query:
-- Inserir conversas
INSERT INTO conversations (customer_id, channel, status, opened_at) 
SELECT id, 'whatsapp', 'waiting', DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 2 HOUR)
FROM customers WHERE name IN ('João Silva', 'Maria Santos', 'Pedro Oliveira');

INSERT INTO conversations (customer_id, channel, status, opened_at, assigned_at, assigned_to)
SELECT id, 'instagram', 'assigned', DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 5 HOUR), DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 4 HOUR), 1
FROM customers WHERE name IN ('Ana Costa', 'Carlos Ferreira');

-- Inserir mensagens
INSERT INTO conversation_messages (conversation_id, sender_id, sender_type, content, sent_at)
SELECT c.id, c.customer_id, 'customer', 'Olá! Gostaria de tirar uma dúvida sobre medicamentos.', c.opened_at
FROM conversations c WHERE c.id IN (SELECT id FROM conversations ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 5);
